name: NIH ChestX-ray14
why: NIH says use is unrestricted if you link this download, cite the CVPR 2017 paper, and name the NIH Clinical Center. The files are a large download, so none were copied into this app.

name: MIMIC-CXR
why: PhysioNet requires an approved data-use agreement. That agreement forbids sharing the images on a public website.

name: CheXpert
why: Stanford’s research license does not allow this public app to copy or modify the images.

name: Open-i
statedSize: Search index, not a license grant
why: Open-i does not grant permission to copy figures. Copyright stays with each journal.

name: The Cancer Imaging Archive
why: Each collection has its own license. Series already indexed here are not counted as single images.

name: LIDC-IDRI lung CT
why: The files are DICOM volumes, not single web images, and were not downloaded.

name: NIH DeepLesion
why: The download is a research CT set. No files from that Box folder were copied.

name: Visible Human
statedSize: CT and MRI of two cadavers
why: NLM requires its own license. The scans were not copied.

name: OpenNeuro
why: Each dataset has its own license and the files are not ordinary web images.

name: OASIS Brains
why: Download requires a data-use agreement. Nothing was copied.

name: IXI brain MRI
why: The files are volume data, not pictures this viewer can open. None were converted or copied.

name: TCIA PET-CT collections
why: Open the collection page. A collection is not counted as an image until a permitted picture file is verified.

name: ADNI
why: ADNI requires an application and does not allow these scans to be posted on a public site.

name: Radiopaedia
why: The license is non-commercial and the terms forbid copying the images into this app.

name: MedPix
why: No public image file with a confirmed reuse license was imported.

name: Stanford AIMI datasets
why: This page lists datasets. It does not provide one pack of images this app can copy.

name: Kaggle medical imaging
why: Each dataset has its own license and Kaggle requires a login. None were copied.

name: Project Imaging-X
why: This is a catalogue of datasets, not image files.

name: RadiAnt
why: This opens a viewer program. It does not add images.

name: Horos
why: This is a viewer, not a library of scans.

name: 3D Slicer
why: This is a viewer for volumes you already have. It does not add images.
